en_us: Where there is no peril in the task - there can be no glory in its accomplishment.
zh_cn: 倘若过程中没有曲折艰辛，那也就无法成就最终的荣耀。

en_us: The doorstep of The End... single step now separates you from it.
zh_cn: 终末之地的门户已经打开……只差迈出最后一步了。

en_us: Only because you have fallen does not yet mean you backed down.
zh_cn: 跌倒，并不意味着你将就此踌躇不前。

en_us: Demise is but a temporary inconvenience for a demigod such as you.
zh_cn: 对于如你一样的半神而言，死亡不过是暂时的不便罢了。

en_us: We fall, so that we may learn how to pick ourselves back up.
zh_cn: 我们之所以跌倒，是为了学习如何重新站起来。

en_us: You will endure this loss, and learn from it.
zh_cn: 你将承担这次失败的代价，并从中吸取教训。

en_us: Oblivion rejects you... make use of such opportunity, while you still can.
zh_cn: 湮灭拒绝了你……不要浪费这次机会，趁你还有能力时好好利用它。

en_us: A setback, but not a defeat.
zh_cn: 一次挫折，绝非失败。

en_us: Death may impede your conquest, but only broken will can halt it.
zh_cn: 死亡可能会阻挡你前进的脚步，但只要意志尚存，这就只是暂时的障碍。

en_us: You have eternity to keep trying. Do what it takes.
zh_cn: 不惜一切代价去尝试吧——你的不朽意味着你还有无数次机会。

en_us: Violence calls for vengeance. Return, and dispense it!
zh_cn: 暴力必将唤起复仇。现在回归，还以颜色！

en_us: You are immortal! Return and give that pitiful creature a demonstration of this fact.
zh_cn: 你即为不朽！回归，向那可怜造物展示你的力量！

en_us: The shell is gone... but appalling presence will forever remain imprinted upon this realm.
zh_cn: 它的躯壳已逝……但留下的伤痕仍然深深刻在这方土地之上。

en_us: Its destruction is a small consolation... given the implications of its terrible existence.
zh_cn: 它的毁灭无疑是莫大慰藉……尤其考虑到其存在本身造成的后患。

en_us: Yes, I wandered those lands many times...
A desolate reminder of everything that was, and all that could have been.
zh_cn: 我曾数次游历过这些破碎的陆地……
沧海桑田，繁华转瞬即逝，只留下满目荒凉。

en_us: Another demigod wanders this forsaken land...
Let me accompany you in your journey. Perhaps, you will manage that which others could not.
zh_cn: 又一位游荡在这废弃土地上的半神……
让我在这段旅途中陪伴你吧。人生苦短，但或许你能成就他人穷极一生都无法完成之事。

en_us: Another eon, another wanderer. Another story to be told...
I will observe yours with great curiosity.
zh_cn: 又一个时代，又一位流浪者。又一段故事开始了……
我将以我全部之热情见证你的传说。

en_us: Perhaps, you will be the one to uncover the long-forgotten history of this land...
If so, I must bear witness to your accomplishments.
zh_cn: 或许，你将最终发掘这世界早已遗忘的秘密……
倘若如此，我便是这无上成就的见证者。

en_us: Sulfur in the air, sharp scent of burnt rock and flesh...
This place is a Hell indeed.
zh_cn: 空气中弥漫着刺鼻的硫磺味、烧焦的大地，烧焦的尸体……
这便是名副其实的地狱。

en_us: Tortured rocks, pale as bones, hanged up above infinite, all-consuming blackness.
The End... is almost like a fever dream.
zh_cn: 扭曲的、如骨般苍白的岩石，漂浮在这片无尽的、择人而噬的虚空之上。
末地……就如同一场荒唐的幻梦。

en_us: The world breathes relieved without the burdensome presence of that horror...
So long at least.
zh_cn: 从如此沉重的恐怖之中解放出来，这世界都仿佛松了一口气……
至少，暂时如此。

en_us: Whether it is power, or redemption that you seek in repeatedly returning Wither from and to its grave...
...at least, you give that damnable creature a purpose.
zh_cn: 在你不断让凋灵复生而又亲手将其送入坟墓之时……你是否找到了你所追求的力量或救赎呢？
至少，你为这该死的生物赋予了存在的意义。

en_us: Poor creature... The last of her kind, bound to guard the godforsaken island...
...in the middle of nothingness. Lay her to the deserved rest.
zh_cn: 可怜的生物……最后一条巨龙，孤单的守护着同样孤单的岛屿……
……直到永恒。让它得到真正的安息吧。

en_us: What a horrible existence... Brought back from the dead, only to be slain once more.
You must truly be devoid of compassion.
zh_cn: 可悲、可怜……打扰它的长眠，只为再次让它体会到死亡的苦痛……
你可是真的毫无慈悲啊。

en_us: Countless dead souls, merged into abomination of such terrible form that it defies description.
The earth is stained by the very presence of this foul creature.
zh_cn: 无穷无尽的逝去的灵魂，其怨念最终化成了难以言表的恐怖怪物……
位于如此邪恶的生物之下，这片大地都在恐惧中颤抖。

en_us: With dragon's imminent demise, this place seems even more empty and purposeless than before.
Will you wander those fractured, deserted lands...
...or return to the facade of sanity and liveliness the Overworld provides?
Of course, we both know the answer... you cannot resist exploring the unknown, be it now or later.
zh_cn: 随着末影龙的逝去，这片虚空变得比以往更加空旷、更加毫无生机。
你会继续向着这片破碎的大地深处探索……
……还是回到主世界，回到理智与活力的怀抱中？
当然，你我都心知肚明……你无法抗拒探索这片无尽的未知的冲动，只是时间早晚的问题。

en_us: ...its terrifying form is destructible, but not its soul.
It bears curse not dissimilar to yours... Curse of immortality.
zh_cn: ……它可怖的躯壳并非永生，但它的灵魂永不安息。
它身上有着不死的诅咒……与你所背负的如出一辙。

en_us: With the toll paid, you are free from the burdensome swell of hatred and sorrow...
...imprisoned in that ring.
zh_cn: 命运的代价得到了支付。你终于能够从这戒指所带来的仇恨与悲伤中……
……得到救赎与解脱。
